mapper.select: SELECT id, provider_code AS providerCode, model_id AS modelId, display_name AS displayName, capability, price, enabled FROM model_config
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_config (provider_code, model_id, display_name, capability, price, enabled) VALUES (#{providerCode}, #{modelId}, #{displayName}, #{capability}, #{price}, COALESCE(#{enabled}, 1))
